title: Squid Game Wake Up Music
blurb: Nothing about this music suggests you are in danger, and that is the trick. Squid Game wakes its players each morning with Haydn's Trumpet Concerto, written in 1796 and about as far from the situation in that dormitory as music can reasonably get. The show uses classical recordings the way a hotel uses soft lighting — to make an appalling operation look orderly. Thirty seconds of relentless brightness. It works surprisingly well as a real alarm tone, and rather cruelly as one for a flatmate who has seen the series.
origin: Haydn's Trumpet Concerto in E-flat major, used as the players' morning wake-up call in Squid Game.
